purpose: Independently assess and adversarially review exact protected-target reference binding without disclosing protected observations, target-derived quality metadata or private binding status to discovery/formalization/review.

authority.classification: Versioned reference resolution within the existing target/semantic/access contracts. No new scientific meaning, exposure exception, unseen-history claim or scientific admission.
authority.basis: FORMALIZATION.md defines data_snapshot_ref as requested scope; the pure outcome interface leaves reference authentication to its caller. New explicit schemas resolve an immutable public declaration to an exact private version without reinterpreting legacy direct references.

reviewed_invariants: research-data-target/1 is host-issued from explicit calendar/instrument scope and an intact development feature certificate, its public catalog and full development definitions. Creation does not look up a protected snapshot or depend on protected certification success.
protected-data-binding/1 remains an operator-owned assessment-class artifact. Successful and failed private bindings do not rewrite the public declaration or change its model-visible packet.

Private binding compares complete definitions, parameters and specification version plus exact catalog content, partition and scope coverage. Matching names/types/units alone cannot pass a changed delay or other meaning.

compile_hypothesis requires an explicit non-null private binding for a declared target. There is no latest-binding selection or silent rebind. Compiled provenance retains the chosen binding, actual snapshot and certificates; the original candidate retains its public reference unchanged.
The existing direct-snapshot branch retains strict snapshot/catalog identity and its previous reference meaning. Numeric compile_payload and outcome semantics are unchanged.

Private binding artifacts and their known descendants cannot enter discovery/formalizer contexts, including through development wrappers. Active worker reads remain limited to the exact authorized public artifact set.

Optional declared-target lookup is conditioned on membership in both original source_refs and authorization_snapshot. Arbitrary references in retained DATA_GAP candidates cannot become private existence/schema probes.

Target meaning review requires the original public declaration explicitly in its context and supplies its full public body alongside formalization/catalog/definitions. Direct-reference review packets do not gain that field.
The meaning-to-plan mapping requires the exact public definition identity through a verified private binding; the direct route keeps its exact private certificate-definition identity rule.

Technical revocation follows target to development certification, private binding to target/snapshot/private certification, and compiled artifact to the explicit private binding. Public historical declarations remain unchanged.
Allocation, scientific readiness, protected execution and freeze remain false or denied. No qualified-development pass is transported into protected-target admission.

limits: Protected market inputs in these integration tests are synthetic. No real protected market rows were inspected by this reviewer, and no actual protected market evaluation was performed.

ScriptedProvider with mode=live is used only to exercise the existing transport mode. It makes no model/network calls; its UTF-8 byte accounting is synthetic and does not measure real token use or model-review quality.
Packet invariance is demonstrated for the fixed exercised changes, not a general proof against every covert channel, trusted-host compromise or operating-system side channel.
Selection chronology and unknown external/model knowledge remain separate. A public target declaration alone does not prove unexposed history, ex-ante independent selection or scientific allocation.

Feature parameter identity and technical source replay do not establish historical publication/vintage, rights acceptance for protected use, outcome eligibility, calibrated inference or profitability.
The resolver and numeric-child compatibility were inspected, and direct plan-review regressions passed. This report does not claim exhaustive replay of every previously retained source package.
The plan path still accepts development bindings only. The tested private meaning-reference mapping does not imply a completed protected evaluation plan or freeze.
No paid calls were made by this reviewer; no scientific contract or production file was edited by this reviewer.
